All he could see was the figure riding the clouds and slipping through the mists among the pine boughs and bamboo groves. Knowing this was no ordinary man, Truong crept along behind him, parting the grass to find a path, and went on for several leagues. passages.text: Each commander's division sends out more than a thousand soldiers every night, dispersed to spread pestilence across the land. You should prepare an abundant feast and set it out in your courtyard. Having come from afar, they are sure to be hungry and thirsty, and at the sight of the food they will eat without a second thought. Hide yourself somewhere in the shadows, and when you see that they have nearly finished eating and drinking, only then come forth and prostrate yourself before them. Yet do not plead for anything at all. In this way, perhaps, some part of the calamity may yet be averted.
